events.verdict: Replay review of the out of bounds called on Bulls (CHI) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Porzingis (CHI) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds and play resumes with Chicago possession.
Giddey's (CHI) shot attempt does not make contact with the rim and the shot clock expires.
Vucevic (CHI) maintains verticality and absorbs the contact that occurs during Johnson's (ATL) layup attempt.
Vucevic (CHI) is not established in a screening position in Young's (ATL) path when he delivers contact.
Jones (CHI) maintains a legal guarding position during Young's (ATL) drive to the basket.
Vucevic (CHI) places his hand against Young (ATL) during the pick and the contact is marginal.
Daniels (ATL) maintains a legal guarding position during Giddey's (CHI) drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Daniels (ATL) briefly grasps Giddey's (CHI) arm on the perimeter.
Young (ATL) commits a take foul on Jones (CHI).
